{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D1F2F), merino wool

Tailored textured jacket, slightly cropped, single-breasted, black with a gold thread fleck (#1F1C1A), bouclé tweed
Long wrap coat, straight cut, mid-calf, camel (#B98B5E), soft wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots, pointed toe, block heel, black (#141414), smooth leather
Small structured top-handle bag, mustard yellow (#D4A017), leather
Drop earrings, gold tone (#C9A24B), polished metal
Sheer tights, black (#1A1A1A), fine knit

This outfit takes a bold route to standing out through color. Burgundy and emerald sit together with confidence, and the mustard bag adds one more accent without crowding the look. The satin pleats move beautifully when you walk to your seat, and the textured jacket keeps the whole look neat and theatre-appropriate.
